verdict.rationale: The Gemini API is itself an AI model service, and its docs show task delegation through agents and background execution, function calling to take real-world actions, and a Managed Agents public preview. However, there is no evidence of a built-in assistant users can hand tasks to inside the product. Delegation means building your own agent on top of the API. Missing for 10: a documented in-product assistant experience, depth on Managed Agents beyond a changelog mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution.
